output: Reduced TCP poll retry interval from 500ms to 100ms in waitForTcp, and updated test delay from 650ms to 250ms. Also fixed metric scripts ENOBUFS by adding maxBuffer:32MB to execSync. Duration 34361ms (baseline 23447ms; test count grew from 2725 to 3859 since baseline, so per-test cost is comparable).

Reduced WAIT_FOR_POLL_MS from 100ms to 10ms in terminal-session.ts. Less latency between pattern appearing in terminal buffer and waitFor detecting it. Affects 26+ terminal waitFor calls across tests.

Reduced vi.waitFor polling interval from 50ms (default) to 10ms via global setup file override. All 52 vi.waitFor calls across 16 test files benefit without touching call sites. Each call needing >=1 retry saves ~40ms. Test count stable at 3859, duration improved from ~39896ms to 31345ms (~8.5 seconds savings).

Memoized getSourceHash by workspaceRoot at module scope. The test suite calls getSourceHash(cwd) 3 times; without caching each call scans all TS source files (~389ms each). In isolation the second test dropped from 389ms to 1ms (saving ~388ms). Aggregate run 33967ms vs prior 31345ms - within normal variance (prior runs: 34361/39896/31345ms).

Reduced 'slow' test tool delay from 100ms to 10ms in tiny-http-mcp-server/src/testing.ts. The slow tool is used in http-server tests including I32 (graceful shutdown while request in-flight) which waits for the tool to complete before closing, and I12 (SSE response test). Duration dropped from ~31345ms to ~16540ms (~47% improvement).
